title: Usability Evaluation of Cloud for HPC Applications
problem: Unclear whether cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP) provide equivalent performance and usability for HPC workloads compared to on-premises HPC clusters.
motivation: Cloud dominates economically; scientific workflows need portability and reproducibility; need empirical evidence to guide HPC migration decisions.
method: Cross-platform usability study: 11 HPC proxy apps/benchmarks across 3 clouds, 6 environments, CPU/GPU configs, scaling to 28,672 CPUs and 256 GPUs, benchmarked against LLNL on-premises clusters.
key_novelty: Comprehensive comparative study of cloud-HPC convergence across multiple platforms, scaling factors, and workload types.
contributions: Cross-cloud empirical evaluation of HPC workload performance (Azure, AWS, GCP)
Systematic scaling study up to 28K CPUs and 256 GPUs
Best practices for running HPC in cloud environments
primary_theme: Cloud suitability for HPC: cross-platform empirical study
